models.role: Photovoltaic wings feed nearby connected equipment. Dust reduces output.
Stores surplus energy and supplies up to 5 power during deficits.
Reliable concept power source. Tier 3 fabrication; fiction, not certified reactor hardware.
Extends power connections from 20 to 38 metres. Glowing cables show the grid.
Consumes stored water and power to replenish the outpost oxygen reservoir.
Processes recovered raw ice, or extracts beside a surveyed ice deposit in the cold-highland analog. Requires power.
A powered service zone draws stored oxygen, charges suits and protects against exposure.
Consumes water and power to make rations. Glazed ribs protect the crop trays.
Build basic kits from gathered materials. Unlocks industry and survey instruments.
Processes regolith into structural alloy. Conversion is a game abstraction.
Adds 100 kg to shared cargo capacity after assembly. Stores the expedition stock.
Links instruments to base within 260m or another linked relay within 360m.
A powered, linked station records one research package per sector.
Three powered linked anchors at least 20m apart form a seismic research array.
Records a geological district package and unlocks tier 3 after three sectors are explored.
Linked observations require clear or high-cloud conditions and open sky.
Runs a 45-second local mapping sortie and reveals nearby resource sites.
A persistent lit waypoint with a map marker for route planning.
A six-metre load-bearing deck for crossing shallow hollows; rotate to align it.
An inclined four-metre deck for reaching higher surfaces and assembled walkways.
